question: Should the experimental update preview expose only a redacted capability projection for MCP changes, and is the resulting versioned core plan contract approved to land in this stack?
rationale: The correct disclosure boundary for a user-facing preview and the decision to add this core contract are product/security choices that cannot safely be inferred from the RFC reference or tests alone.

options.title: Redact and sponsor the contract
options.body: Replace raw MCP value rendering with an explicit redacted capability projection, add regression coverage, and approve the bounded experimental core contract.

options.title: Defer the core contract
options.body: Keep the stacked PRs open until maintainers decide whether grouped Claw lifecycle updates belong in core rather than an extension-owned surface.

recommendation.title: Redact and sponsor the contract
recommendation.body: Replace raw MCP value rendering with an explicit redacted capability projection, add regression coverage, and approve the bounded experimental core contract.
